negative.title: Negative tests
negative.intro: Sends altered copies of your saved requests: missing or invalid credentials, bad bodies, boundary values and injection strings. This is a basic checker, not a penetration testing tool. Run it against a test or staging environment.
negative.noHosts: The addresses of these requests could not be resolved to a host. Check the environment variables they use.
negative.confirm: I may send altered requests to these hosts
negative.plan_one: {{count}} altered copy of your requests will be sent.
negative.plan_other: {{count}} altered copies of your requests will be sent.
negative.noFindingsHint: This does not show the API is secure. It only checks a few common mistakes.

finding.accepted: {{label}}: the server answered {{status}}, a rejection (4xx) was expected
finding.stackTrace: {{label}}: the response body shows a stack trace
finding.sqlError: {{label}}: the response body shows a database error
finding.reflected: {{label}}: the payload is returned unchanged in the response body
